Bahadur rooh bina audience ke khoon bahaati hai.
Khamoshi ko apni grit ka anvil banao.
Grit khud par ek shaant jeet hai.
Andhere ko tab tak ghooro jab tak rooh na chamke.
Khaamosh toofaan bhaari vriksh tod dete hain.
Komal fusfusahat garajte topf ko maat deti hai.
Hausla akelapan mein bana loha hai.
Sannata veero ka kavach hai.
Sahanbhuti bolti hai jab hont band ho.
Sabse gahre zakhm band honton ke peeche chhupe hain.
Veerta shaant raat mein soti hai.
Chupchaap sangharsh karo; zor se jeeto.
Aansoo bina dikhe girte hain hausle ke raaste par.
Ek shaant dil sabse tez aandhi ko sahta hai.
Hausla wahan palta hai jahan shabd murjha jaate hain.
Bahadur purush kisi fani zubaan ke aage nahi jhukte.
Sannata taaj ka bojh uthata hai.
Lohe ki haddiyan aur shaant saans samay ko jeet-ti hain.
Bahadur bina chillaye aag se gujarte hain.
Hausla aatma ki ankahee fusfusahat hai.
Hausla sabse andheri aadha raat mein khilta hai.
Tehraye paani sabse unchi aandhi ko duba dete hain.
Ansuni pratigya sangmarmar se bhi lambi tikegi.
Mook yodha tutte tare ki tarah var karta hai.
Dard dridh aatma se dheere se baat karta hai.
Hausla andhere raaston par akela chalta hai.
Sacchi veerta ko kisi goonjti aawaz ki zarurat nahi.
Shaant sahanbhuti pahad ki deewar tod deti hai.
